name: Ruu
source:
A girl who naturally seems to get herself into trouble.
She's been pestering Senri ever since he saved her once, though she hasn't realized that her attention is bothering him.
She seems unaware of the danger inherent in walking around alone at nights, perhaps because she's had a sheltered upbringing, or perhaps because she's simply not too bright.
While seemingly a powerless girl, unable to use magic, no matter how much trouble she gets in, she strangely always comes out of it smiling, with not a scratch on her.
